page.seo_title: Meet the team — Cafeina La Marina
page.seo_description: Meet Millie and Callum, the family behind Cafeina. Pouring love into every coffee since 2009.
page.hero_subheading: Millie, Callum and the team who keep Cafeina running.
page.hero_landscape_image_alt: Coffee, notebook and a moment to linger at Cafeina
page.intro_body: We're a family-run café — which means the face pouring your coffee is the same face who bakes the cake, takes the booking, and locks up at the end of the night. Pop in and say hello.
page.cta_text: Open Mon–Sat from 9am, Sun from 5pm. Table service, homemade cakes, and a warm welcome.

members.name: Millie
members.tagline: Carrying Cafeina's legacy forward, one welcome at a time
members.bio: Millie first came to Cafeina as an employee under its original founder, Maria, learning the rhythms of the café and the warmth that keeps regulars coming back. Now, together with Callum, she's carrying that legacy forward — baking, serving, and greeting every guest with the same care that made this corner of La Marina feel like home for the last fifteen years.
members.photo_alt: Millie, co-owner of Cafeina La Marina

members.name: Callum
members.tagline: A stickler for good ingredients and a properly made Negroni
members.bio: Callum runs front-of-house and the craft cocktail side of the bar. A stickler for good ingredients and a properly made Negroni, he's the one you'll usually find chatting with regulars, recommending a wine, or stirring up the weekly cocktail special behind the counter.
